description.text: Research direction: Grammar of Contemporary Chinese Language, Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language, Chinese Language History, Dialectology, Computational Linguistics, Grammar of Chinese Language and Vocabulary, Phonetics and Phonology of Chinese Language, Grammatical History of Chinese Language, Ancient Chinese Character

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Chinese Character at Shanghai Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year
